facilities.name: Main Auditorium & Grand Conference Hall

Ideal for summits, conventions, graduations, and institutional assemblies.

plans.name: Individual Professional
plans.description: Designed for consultants, professionals, and lifelong learners seeking an inspiring environment, facility discounts, and high-level networking.
benefits: 10 Hours complimentary meeting room credits per month
20% discount on Auditorium and Lab bookings
Access to Ten42 digital resource library

plans.name: Student & Early Career
plans.description: Subsidized membership for verified tertiary students and emerging young changemakers committed to personal development and skill acquisition.

Free entry to selected monthly masterclasses
plans.eligibility: Valid student ID card or national youth service letter required.

benefits: Access to open community networking forums
Discounted day pass to coworking spaces
